messages:
emma_partnerships: Heads up — HelioGrid PO HG-9002 failed marketplace ingest. Partner portal returned EDI error 451 and tax_jurisdiction mismatch. Customer facing procurement hold for their appliance order.

julio_procure: grabbing the PO now. We see billing entity set to HelioGrid EU but tax id is US EIN. Portal rejects during validation.

ops_bot: Automated alert: PO HG-9002 validation failed. Error: {"code":451, "msg":"Tax jurisdiction mismatch: declared EU vs EIN country US"}.

liam_sales: customer says their finance ops pushed an updated PO with VAT number, but the marketplace ACK came back before the update landed. Theyneed the order accepted today to meet customs ETA.

vijay_vendor: from HelioGrid finance: we did update VAT on our side but our EDI gateway still sends legacy EID field `EIN123` for older SKUs. We can change but may take >24h. Any temporary workaround?

nina_legal: if the issue is only metadata mismatch we can accept a corrected commercial invoice + vendor affidavit that confirms intended tax jurisdiction. But Procurement & Ops need an auditable trail before we bypass automated validation.

julio_procure: Proposed quick fixes: 1) remap vendor alias to accept both VAT/EIN variants for HG-9002 (fast), 2) accept manual invoice override in portal (requires manager sign-off), 3) ask HelioGrid to resend corrected EDI (slower). Which path do we take?

emma_partnerships: prefer (1) + (3). Remap alias temporarily, then ask for corrected EDI and final invoice. Ops: can you run alias patch and force a portal retry?

ops_bot: alias-patch job queued: `alias-patch --vendor HG --po HG-9002 --allow-alt-tax=EIN123,VAT-EU`. Job id 44210. ETA 3m.

ops_bot: alias-patch job completed (id:44210). Portal staging refreshed.

julio_procure: requesting HelioGrid resend accepted. Sent note: "Please resend PO HG-9002 with corrected VAT field and attach a signed commercial invoice to expedite customs."

vijay_vendor: resend initiated at 2026-07-12T09:12:05Z. Gateway shows ACK queued.

ops_bot: Portal ACK received and processed. New validation state: ACCEPTED (manual alias match).

liam_sales: confirming with customer — HelioGrid sees ACK now. Thanks all.

nina_legal: legal follow-up: we still need the commercial invoice + vendor affidavit in our contract system. Please upload to contracts@redwood with subject "HG-9002 tax doc". Once received I'll clear the temporary acceptance note and close out the audit entry.

julio_procure: uploaded invoice: https://files.redwood/hg/invoices/HG-9002-commercial.pdf. Noted in PO ledger.

emma_partnerships: closing loop: alias patched, portal accepted, customer notified, legal awaiting doc sign-off. If legal flags anything we'll re-open.

vijay_vendor: docs uploaded from HelioGrid side as well. Appreciate the fast help.

liam_sales: great cross-team response. Keep me posted if legal needs more evidence — customer is shipping on Friday so timing is tight. :rocket:
